relations.quote: In June 2025, BASF and Norwegian energy company Equinor signed a long-term strategic agreement for the annual delivery of up to 23 terawatt hours (around 2 billion cubic meters) of natural gas over a period of ten years.

relations.product: long-term supply of renewable electricity for chemical production in Europe
relations.quote: At the same time, BASF continues its collaboration with Vattenfall, securing a long-term supply of electricity from renewable sources for chemical production in Europe
relations.label: BASF annual report: BASF Report 2025 (02-27-2026)

relations.product: Hollandse Kust Zuid offshore wind farm (joint project) supplying electricity to BASF's European production sites
relations.quote: The Hollandse Kust Zuid offshore wind farm, a joint project with Vattenfall and Allianz, has been operational since the summer of 2024. With 139 turbines and a capacity of 1.5 gigawatts, it is one of the largest subsidy-free offshore wind farms in the world. We use the electricity generated to supply our production sites in Europe, particularly Ludwigshafen, Germany.
relations.label: BASF annual report: BASF Report 2025 (02-27-2026)

relations.product: renewable electricity supplying 100% of the Zhanjiang Verbund site

relations.product: graphite raw material for BASF's Neopor insulation material
relations.quote: In another project with raw material supplier Graphit Kropfmühl, we agreed on an innovative approach to reducing the carbon footprint of its products. We supply the company with Guarantees of Origin for electricity from renewable sources, reducing the PCF of the graphite produced. We then use the graphite as a raw material to reduce the PCF of our insulation material Neopor®.
relations.label: BASF annual report: BASF Report 2025 (02-27-2026)
